beats.say: 2,941,390,588 dollars: Avengers: Endgame sits at number one for worldwide box office takings, enough to buy millions of cinema tickets over decades.
Titanic comes in at number five, pulling in 2,257,906,828 dollars back in 1997.
Avatar: The Way of Water takes number four with 2,334,484,620 dollars.

beats.say: Spider-Man: Brand New Day claims third place with 2,517,281,128 dollars.
Avatar holds number two, just behind the top spot with 2,923,710,708 dollars.

facts: Avengers: Endgame is ranked number 1 with a worldwide gross of $2,941,390,588 in 2019.
Avatar is ranked number 2 with a worldwide gross of $2,923,710,708 in 2009.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day is ranked number 3 with a worldwide gross of $2,517,281,128 in 2026.
Avatar: The Way of Water is ranked number 4 with a worldwide gross of $2,334,484,620 in 2022.
Titanic is ranked number 5 with a worldwide gross of $2,257,906,828 in 1997.
